findings: Round-4 FAIL fixed (9:16 baseline-es): 'Expediente del remitente' now sits left of the folder (x582-746, y554-619 at 1080 px width). 'Archivado' is above-right of the folder, 'devuelto' beside its dashed arrow.

Round-4 FAIL fixed (9:16 contrast-or-alternative): 'Sending office file' is left of the folder (y567-606) and 'Acknowledgment (kept)' above the card (y723-788), 117 px apart and offset horizontally. 'Envelope' is below-right of the envelope, clear of the 'delivered' line. 'dispatched' is beside its arrow.
Round-4 minor fixed: 9:16 baseline 'Acknowledgment card' measures 20.4 px at 1080 px width. Every 9:16 caption in baseline, es and alternative is 20.4-22.1 px, and status tags are 20.5 px.

Round-4 minor fixed: the dot on the 'kept by' / 'custodiado por' connector is absent at t=0.40 (9:16 es and 1:1). At t=0.41 it appears together with its line stub at the folder corner, and the full line and label follow by t=0.43.

By design and unchanged: the stamp and pen briefly thin the card caption as they pass (16:9 t~0.69-0.72). Thinning happens only in transit. Automated checks confirm no label stays thinned at rest or in the final hold.

Dense strips at t=0.30-1.0 (9:16 es and alternative), t=0.46-0.82 (16:9) and t=0.50-0.92 (9:16 en) show the expected order. The relations are drawn one at a time. The tracer carries the envelope to the IN tray. Delivery comes before signing (pen on the card), then the stamp, then the copy's return to the folder, then the Delivered, Signed and Filed tags. The labels-hidden strip reads without text: trays, envelope, notice, card, folder and people. No clipping, teleporting or detached tags were seen.

Minor, not blocking (1:1 baseline-es): the two-line relation label 'custodiado por' (17.5 px) sits on the same row, 22 px left of the folder caption 'Expediente del remitente'. In 1:1 en, 'kept by' sits 32 px left of 'Sender's notice file'. Both relation labels have dotted leaders to the Sender-folder connector, so they stay attributable. A wider gap or a spot below the arc would read better.

Minor, not blocking (9:16 es): 'Bandeja de salida' sits 24 px above the relation label 'va dentro de'. 'custodiado por' sits 39 px above 'Expediente del remitente'. Leaders and different chip sizes keep them distinct.

Minor, stress preset only (long-labels-stress): relation labels drop to 13.4-16.3 px in 1:1 and 14.7-17.9 px in 9:16. 'enclosed in the envelope' (9:16) and 'kept by the coordinator' (1:1) sit about 110-190 px from their connectors on long dotted leaders that do land on the right line. Meaning is kept.

Distinct treatment: the four treatments are distinct compositions. LAW-0034 is a node-graph mechanism loop: trays, envelope, notice, card and folder around two parties, with a traced delivery-and-record route. LAW-0033 is a top-down desk hand-off story, LAW-0035 is paired desk scenes for the contrast, and LAW-0036 is a lens inspecting the card's 'Received by' field.

Legal content: labels are descriptive only (dispatched, delivered, received by, signs and dates, returned, kept by, Delivered/Signed/Filed). The watermark reads 'Illustrative example - fictional - jurisdiction unspecified'. The alternative only changes whether the acknowledgment is returned and filed. No validity, deadline or legal effect is asserted.
